interface.defaultPrompt: @XCE_SCRIBE: Write the screenplay from my idea and prepared cast, then hand the scene and role breakdown to XCE_DIRECTOR.
interface.longDescription: XCE_SCRIBE v1.0.2 works in the same chat under the XCE production system. Studio production follows UNIFY → SCRIBE → DIRECTOR (preproduction casting & asset inventory) → IGNITION (reuse or create only missing references) → DIRECTOR (shot readiness) → MV (cinematic shots) → DIRECTOR (dailies) → UNIFY. Supplied anchors may be cast by role; new/mixed anchors supported; no website or automatic external save. Runs in this chat; fetches anchors read-only from XSTUDIO through the XCE app when connected. Core rules v2.0: one frame per image, numbered frames, per-frame review gate (A/X/R/B), invideo video from approved frames, native audio only, never music.

name: xce-script-standalone
description: Screenplay and scene breakdown handed to XCE_DIRECTOR before asset and shot generation.
